pr_title: ttl: add `ttl_job_interval` attribute and remove `tidb_ttl_job_interval` variable
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: YangKeao <yangkeao@chunibyo.icu>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #40028

Problem Summary:

The global config `tidb_ttl_job_interval` is not flexible enough. We could add an attribute for every table to configure different scan / delete frequency.

### What is changed and how it works?

Add a new attribute `ttl_job_interval` to the table, and use this attribute to decide whether this job could be scheduled.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

### Release note

```release-note
Allow configuring different ttl job frequency for tables.
```

issue_context.title: ttl job scheduler configuration per table
issue_context.body: Now we are using a single global variable `tidb_ttl_job_run_interval` to control the interval between TTL jobs. We could add an attribute `ttl_cronjob_schedule` to control the interval per table.

review_comments: Because it doesn't support 'd', and the stringify of it is not stable. (For 1 hour, sometimes return `1h0s`, sometimes `1h0m0s`. I didn't inspect it further).
